<action type="say">
I found your order ODR-108901 with one item:

- Running Shoes (item ID: SKU-889), status: delivered, return-eligible
- Return window: 30 days from delivery
- Supported methods: dropoff and pickup

I can definitely start a dropoff return for these shoes.

For the exchange to size 10.5: in this system, exchanges are tied to specific size variants, but your order data doesn’t expose the size/variant IDs I’d need to wire up an automatic “swap” to 10.5 directly.

Given that, there are two clean ways to proceed:

1) Return + new order (simplest, fastest):
   - I create a dropoff return for the existing pair.
   - You either:
     • place a new order yourself for the same model in size 10.5, or  
     • tell me your shipping address and I’ll walk you through placing that new order here.

2) Try to treat it as an in-system exchange:
   - This would still require effectively placing a new order for size 10.5 once the return is accepted, so it ends up similar to option 1 in practice.

Which do you prefer?

If you’re fine with option 1 (return + new order), I’ll go ahead and:
- Create a dropoff return for item SKU-889, qty 1, reason “Size too large”.
- Then ask for your shipping ZIP (for the new size 10.5 pair) so we can either estimate cost/ETA or set up the new order.

Tell me:
- Do you want to proceed with option 1 (return + new order)?
- And do you still want dropoff for the return (yes/no)?</action>
